As expected, Omni Group has been working all summer to ensure all of its applications are ready to support Apple's 2027 system update on day one. Here's what's included in this update.

Omni Group releases updates to its app suite for Apple's 2027 system launch

Omni Group CEO Ken Case said in a blog post titled "Hey Siri, We're Ready!" that the development teams behind OmniGraffle, OmniOutliner, OmniPlan, and OmniFocus have been working tirelessly to ensure all of the company's applications are "fully prepared and compatible with updates across all Apple platforms."

Here's what Case shared:

The highlight of this update is OmniFocus 4.9, with full support for macOS 27 Golden Gate, iOS 27, iPadOS 27, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27. The new version adds Siri AI support, date parsing powered by Apple Intelligence, "a collection of new and updated App Intents presented as Shortcuts actions," and design refinements to match Apple's 2027 system update.

OmniFocus users can now use Siri to set and edit due dates, tags, notes, and even repeat schedules. The app also supports other Siri AI features, such as on-screen content awareness and Visual Intelligence, helping users add content to OmniFocus more quickly.

Siri AI can now also use users' personal data—in practice, this means it can answer questions based on the user's OmniFocus database, summarise to-dos, suggest next actions, and convert follow-up items from meeting notes into reminders.

Other Omni Group updates this week include:

  • OmniOutliner 6.3 also adopts Liquid Glass design refinements across all Apple platforms.
  • OmniFocus and OmniOutliner now feature new APIs that let users and tools search the Omni Automation API, which should make it easier to find the documentation you need when writing scripts.
  • Omni Group says this work is also part of its rollout of the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Finally, Case also mentioned that, following last week's announcement of the iPhone Duo, the team has begun preparing its apps for the launch of this foldable device.
